title: Unraveling the science of “sinking and dark-colored” superior agarwood through density, color, and metabolomics
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15697-15708
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08081A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yanan Yuan, Mengyuan Yang, Yujiao Zhao, Zhidong Qiu
Using density, color, and UPLC-MS, this study validates the traditional wisdom that sinking, darker agarwood (density > 0.7) is enriched in chromone dimers, while lower-density wood has more monomers, providing chemical markers for quality assessment.
